pins.definition: The organ in the chest that pumps blood through the body.
The organ in the chest that pumps blood through the body.
The organ in your chest that pumps blood through your body.

situation: A medical student at a lab desk examines a preserved anatomical specimen under a bright gooseneck lamp.
subject: the human heart organ
brief: An anatomical illustration rendered on yellowed paper shows a detailed human heart, with its branching aorta and vena cava precisely delineated. Delicate fine-line ink notes and subtle red watercolours map the muscular walls and chambers of the blood-pumping organ.
prompt: An anatomical illustration rendered on yellowed paper shows a detailed human heart, with its branching aorta and vena cava precisely delineated. Delicate fine-line ink notes and subtle red watercolours map the muscular walls and chambers of the blood-pumping organ. a nineteenth-century engraved scientific plate, fine hatching, hand-tinted washes, aged rag paper, the specimen isolated and reverently observed. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
